changelog: Say "change Kamal to Kamalpur" — or "কামালের বদলে কামালপুর লিখো" in Bengali — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and that word is replaced wherever it sits in the message, in one step instead of deleting it and dictating the correction; the cursor parks right after the new word so you can keep dictating. Gboard's Pixel 8+ "Change [word] to [word]" command, now on this keyboard in English and Bengali.
